title: 第558章 万若曦第557章 灭周家
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
“不悔，你去敲敲门。”
背负双手的云峰则看着女儿笑了起来，让女儿去敲门。
“好的爸爸。”
林不悔点了点头，过去敲门了。
彭！
彭彭！
刚刚敲了没两下门，门就开启了，一个妇人出现在了云峰和林不悔的面前。
云峰仔细一看，这个妇人大概20多岁的样子，头上盘着高高的发髻，肤色白嫩，身材也算丰满，长相秀丽。
不过眉宇间却有一股隐藏不住的忧愁。
“你们是谁？”
看到外面的云峰和林不悔后，这个妇人则惊讶的询问道。
“请问姑娘芳名可叫万若曦？”
云峰则询问道。
“你怎么知道我的名字？你是谁？”
听到云峰的话后，万若曦顿时警惕了起来，目光炯炯的看着云峰。
“嗯，别误会，我叫……我姓厉。”
云峰本来想说出自己的姓名的，不过想到这里灵界，高级修士遍地走，危险重重，而且最近他还刚刚杀了周龙，而是保险一些好，所以用了一个假的姓，称呼自己姓厉。
“这是我的女儿，可以请我们进去坐坐吗？”
云峰则指着身边的林不悔，笑嘻嘻的询问道。
“这个……”

万若曦似乎有点犹豫，他不认识云峰和林不悔。
“怎么，光天化日之下害怕我对你不不轨吗？”
云峰则笑了起来，觉得眼前的这个女人也太小心了。
“好吧，厉先生，厉小姐请进。”
万若曦似乎也觉得自己小心过头了，则将云峰和林不悔请走进来。
万家的院子还是蛮大的，有青木桌子，养着一些花草什么的。
云峰和林不悔在一处桌前坐下了，万若曦则给两人倒了茶水来，然后她也坐下了，坐在了云峰和不悔对面。
“两位来我家到底有什么事情，厉先生可以说了？”
万若曦看着云峰询问道。
“是这样的，万姑娘，请问你父母在哪里？”
云峰喝了一口茶水，发现茶水是极品铁观音，茶味道很浓重很香。
喝了一口茶水后，他方才询问。
“我母亲很小的时候就过世了，我的父亲在三年前失踪了，至今未归。”
万若曦则说道，神情愁苦。
content_en:
"If you don't regret it, go knock on the door."
Yunfeng, who had his hands behind his back, looked at his daughter and smiled, asking her to knock on the door.
"Okay daddy."
Lin Buhui nodded, went over and knocked on the door.
Peng!
Peng Peng!
Just after knocking twice, the door opened, and a woman appeared in front of Yunfeng and Lin Buhui.
Yunfeng took a closer look and saw that this woman was probably in her 20s, with a high bun on her head, a fair complexion, a plump figure, and a beautiful appearance.
But there was an unconcealable sadness between his brows.
"Who are you?"
Seeing Yunfeng and Lin Buhui outside, the woman asked in surprise.
"May I ask if the girl's name is Wan Ruoxi?"
Yunfeng asked.
"How do you know my name? Who are you?"
After hearing Yunfeng's words, Wan Ruoxi suddenly became alert and looked at Yunfeng with bright eyes.
"Well, don't get me wrong, my name is... my surname is Li."
Yunfeng originally wanted to tell his name, but thinking about the spiritual world, where senior monks were everywhere and there were many dangers, and he had just killed Zhou Long recently, it was better to be safe, so he used a fake surname and called himself Li.
"This is my daughter, can you invite us in and sit down?"
Yunfeng pointed at Lin Buhui beside him and asked with a smile.
"This..."
Wan Ruoxi seemed a little hesitant. He didn't know Yunfeng and Lin Buhui.
"Why, aren't you afraid that I would be unkind to you in broad daylight?"
Yunfeng laughed, feeling that the woman in front of him was too careful.
"Okay, Mr. Li, Miss Li, please come in."
Wan Ruoxi seemed to feel that she was being too careful, so she invited Yunfeng and Lin Buhui in.
Wanjia's yard is quite large, with a green wooden table and some flowers and plants.
Yunfeng and Lin Buhui sat down at a table, Wan Ruoxi poured tea for them, and then she also sat down, sitting opposite Yunfeng and Lin Buhui.
"What's the matter with you two coming to my house? Can Mr. Li tell you?"
Wan Ruoxi looked at Yunfeng and asked.
"That's right, Miss Wan, where are your parents?"
Yunfeng took a sip of tea and found that the tea was the best Tieguanyin. The tea tasted very strong and fragrant.
After taking a sip of tea, he asked.
"My mother passed away when she was very young, and my father disappeared three years ago and has not returned yet."
Wan Ruoxi said, looking sad.
